title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Level Schedule: Price and Sale Limits
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver — Level Schedule: Price and Sale Limits

The Kestrel GAP Waiver is offered at six levels. Each level has its own price, which is included in the amount financed on the Kestrel Auto Finance contract, and its own limits on the loan it can be sold on: the largest amount financed, the longest finance term, the oldest vehicle model age, and the highest loan-to-value at sale.

## Schedule (amounts in USD)

| Level | Waiver price | Maximum amount financed | Maximum finance term | Maximum vehicle model age | Maximum loan-to-value at sale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel GAP Essential | 495.00 | 50000.00 | 72 months | 10 years | 115 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Standard | 595.00 | 60000.00 | 72 months | 10 years | 125 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Plus | 695.00 | 75000.00 | 75 months | 8 years | 125 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Premier | 795.00 | 85000.00 | 75 months | 8 years | 150 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Premier Plus | 895.00 | 100000.00 | 75 months | 7 years | 150 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Max | 995.00 | 125000.00 | 75 months | 7 years | 175 percent |

Months and years are whole numbers. The maximum loan-to-value at sale is the entry limit of each level.

## How loan-to-value is measured

For every level, loan-to-value is measured against the **vehicle cash price** shown on the finance contract: it is the amount financed divided by the vehicle cash price, expressed as a percent.

## Reading the schedule

- The price column is the price of the waiver itself; it is the amount carried in the amount financed for that waiver.
- Each limit is a ceiling for its own level. A loan at exactly the figure shown is within the limit.
- The levels step up in price from Essential to Max. Term and model-age limits do not step up evenly: Essential and Standard share a 72-month term and a 10-year model age; Plus and Premier allow 75 months and 8 years; Premier Plus and Max allow 75 months and 7 years.

### Example (hypothetical figures)

A finance contract with a vehicle cash price of 30000.00 and an amount financed of 37500.00 has a loan-to-value of 125 percent (37500.00 divided by 30000.00). Against this schedule that figure equals the entry limit of Kestrel GAP Standard and Kestrel GAP Plus, is below the entry limit of Premier, Premier Plus and Max, and is above the entry limit of Kestrel GAP Essential.
